Popular science explainers are skilled at replacing difficult theories with everyday metaphors. If you rephrase a “black hole” as “a pit from which even light cannot escape,” a picture forms in the listener’s mind. What matters in communicating is not giving up accuracy but reselecting words and order without losing the implications.

words.defJa: 国と国を分ける境の線

cards.en: If you look at a map, Africa’s border lines are oddly straight, aren’t they? In fact, many of them were not decided by local people but drawn on maps by the European powers to divide up their own spheres of influence, following the Berlin Conference of the late nineteenth century. The distribution of ethnic groups and languages was mostly ignored. The aftereffects are still often cited today as a distant cause of civil wars and ethnic conflict.

It is said to grow not so much from innate talent as from accumulated experience of overcoming small setbacks. It is just like a muscle: the more often you experience a moderate load, the stronger it becomes. That is exactly why parents who step in too early to keep their children from failing may, on the contrary, deprive them of that power.

cards.en: The international order rests, in every age, on the balance of power among great powers. At the Congress of Vienna in 1815, for example, after the Napoleonic Wars, the powers tried to avoid major wars by maintaining a balance of power. This arrangement is said to have restrained a Europe-wide war for about a century after, though imperfectly. Conversely, the moment the balance of power collapses, order too is shaken all at once.

words.defJa: もっとよくなろうとする気持ち

cards.ja: 「向上心がある人」と聞くと、いつも歯を食いしばって努力している姿を思い浮かべるでしょう。ところが実際には、意欲の高い人ほど、周りが思うよりずっと自分を許すのが上手だったりします。失敗を人格の欠陥と捉えず、反省は短く切り上げて、次の一手の材料にできるからです。固定マインドセットに縛られた人は、他人の成功を見るたびに、劣等感ゆえに挑戦そのものを避けてしまいます。その正体は、苦行ではなく、自分への静かな信頼なのでしょう。
cards.en: Hearing “a person with drive to improve,” you probably picture someone gritting their teeth and working all the time. In practice, though, people with high motivation are often far better at forgiving themselves than others imagine. They do not take failure as a flaw of character; they cut reflection short and turn it into material for the next move. People caught in a fixed mindset, each time they see another’s success, avoid the challenge itself out of a sense of inferiority. The real nature of that drive is not austerity but quiet trust in oneself.

cards.en: “Kisha no kisha ga kisha de kisha shita” is a famous homophone game. Said aloud it is all “kisha,” but in kanji the meanings separate cleanly: your company, reporter, steam train, return to the office. Precisely because Japanese has so many Sino-Japanese words, words that are easy to mix up by ear alone turn up beyond counting once you leaf through a dictionary. That is why speakers have long devised workarounds in lectures, such as saying “watakushi-ritsu” for 私立.

words.defJa: 原因と結果のつながり

cards.ja: 歴史を語るとき、年号と人名を並べるだけでは聞き手は眠ってしまいます。大切なのは、出来事のあいだの因果を一本の糸としてたどり、単刀直入に結論から語ることです。たとえば「冷夏で凶作が続き、米価が高騰し、各地で打ちこわしが起きた」と話せば、三つの事実が一つの物語になります。ただし、単純な図式に押し込めすぎると、歴史の複雑さを取りこぼす恐れがあるので注意が必要です。
cards.en: When talking about history, simply lining up dates and names will put your listeners to sleep. What matters is to trace the cause and effect between events as a single thread and to speak straight from the conclusion. If you say, for example, “a cool summer brought successive crop failures, rice prices soared, and riots broke out in many places,” three facts become one story. Be careful, though: squeezing things into a simple causality risks dropping the complexity of history.

words.defJa: 社会や情勢の根本的な大変化

cards.ja: 一九八九年から九一年にかけて、ベルリンの壁の崩壊、東欧の民主化、そしてソ連の解体が立て続けに起きました。これは、冷戦という国際秩序の地殻変動であり、世界地図そのものを塗り替える出来事でした。この変化の最中にいた人々は、毎日のニュースに追われるばかりで、全体像をつかむどころではなかったでしょう。数十年を経た今になって初めて、私たちはその揺れの大きさを実感できるのです。
cards.en: From 1989 to 1991, the fall of the Berlin Wall, the democratization of Eastern Europe and the dissolution of the Soviet Union happened in rapid succession. This was a tectonic shift in the international order known as the Cold War, an event that redrew the world map itself. The people in the midst of this change were probably so chased by daily news that grasping the whole picture was out of the question. Only now, decades later, can we truly feel the size of the tremor.

words.meaning: a lie can be skillful means
words.defJa: 時には嘘が目的にかなう手段になる

cards.ja: 法華経には、燃える家から子どもたちを救うため、父が「門の外に玩具の車がある」と偽って外へ誘い出す話がある。これが「嘘も方便」の元になった譬え話で、目的が衆生の救いであれば、手段としての方便は罪にならないと説かれる。ただし、この言葉が日常で使われるときは、都合の悪いごまかしを正当化する口実に変質しがちだ。本来の仏教の方便は、相手の理解力に応じて教えを噛み砕く、慈悲の技術だったのである。
cards.en: In the Lotus Sutra there is a story in which a father, to save his children from a burning house, lures them outside with the false claim that toy carts are waiting beyond the gate. This is the parable behind “a lie can be skillful means”: if the aim is the salvation of living beings, the means, upaya, is taught not to be a sin. In everyday use, however, the phrase tends to degrade into an excuse for justifying inconvenient fudging. The original Buddhist skillful means was an art of compassion, breaking teachings down according to the listener’s capacity.

words.defJa: 共有地などを柵で囲って私有地にすること

cards.ja: 世界史の試験で「囲い込み」が出たら、まず「羊毛」と「農民」を思い出してください。十六世紀のイギリスでは、羊毛の需要が高まり、地主が農地を柵で囲って牧羊地に変えたため、小作人は村を離れることを余儀なくされました。この第一次の動きに対して、十八〜十九世紀の第二次は、議会の法律によって進められた点が違います。農民が都市へ流れ込んだ結果、工場の労働力が生まれた、という因果まで覚えておくと、論述にも強くなります。
cards.en: If “enclosure” comes up on a world history exam, first recall “wool” and “farmers.” In sixteenth-century England, demand for wool rose, and landlords fenced in farmland and turned it into sheep pasture, so tenants were forced to leave their villages. In contrast to this first movement, the second one, in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, differed in being carried out through acts of Parliament. If you also remember the chain of cause and effect, that farmers flowed into cities and a factory labor force came into being, you will do better on essay questions too.

words.defJa: 語を働きで分けた種類

cards.ja: 学校で丸暗記させられた品詞の分類は、役に立たないと思われがちです。ですが、ある語が名詞なのか形容動詞なのかを見分けられるようになると、文の骨組みがぐっと見えやすくなり、読解の速さも変わります。たとえば「静かな」は形容動詞ですが、「静かに」は副詞的に働く、という具合に、語は文の中で姿を変えるのです。外国語を学ぶ上でも、例文を反復しながらこの感覚を磨くと、強い武器になります。
cards.en: The classification of parts of speech you learned at school tends to be thought useless. But once you can tell whether a word is a noun or a na-adjective, the skeleton of a sentence becomes much easier to see. For example, “shizuka na” is a na-adjective, but “shizuka ni” works adverbially; words change their shape within a sentence. In learning a foreign language too, polishing this sense by repeating example sentences becomes a powerful weapon.

words.defJa: 国民という意識で結ばれた国家

cards.ja: 国民国家とは、同じ言語や歴史を共有する「国民」という意識の上に成り立つ国家である。ヨーロッパでは、フランス革命とナポレオン戦争を経て、君主ではなく国民が主権者だという考え方が広がった。日本も、明治維新後に標準語の整備や徴兵制の導入を進め、地域ごとに異なっていた人々を「日本人」としてまとめあげていった。ただし、国境線の内側に多様な言語や文化が残る国は多く、国民の同質性は、しばしば作られた物語にすぎない。
cards.en: A nation-state is a state built on the consciousness of being a “nation” sharing language and history. In Europe, through the French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars, the idea spread that sovereignty lies with the people, not the monarch. After the Meiji Restoration Japan too pushed standardization of the language and conscription, drawing people who had differed region by region together as “Japanese.” However, many countries retain diverse languages and cultures inside their borders, and national homogeneity is often no more than a constructed story.

words.defJa: 同じ訓読みを持つ別々の漢字

cards.ja: 「はかる」と読む漢字は、測る・計る・量る・図る・諮ると、実にたくさんあります。こうした同訓異字の使い分けは、学習者のみならず、日本語を母語とする人でさえ迷う難所です。長さや深さなら「測る」、時間や数なら「計る」、重さや容積なら「量る」というふうに、対象に注目すると整理しやすくなります。漢字は、和語の曖昧な広がりを細かく切り分けるために先人が磨き上げた道具だったのです。
cards.en: There are plenty of kanji read “hakaru”: 測る, 計る, 量る, 図る, 諮る, and more. Choosing among such same-kun kanji is a stumbling block not only for learners but even for native speakers. If you focus on the object, it sorts out easily: “測る” for length and depth, “計る” for time and numbers, “量る” for weight and volume. Kanji were tools that predecessors honed for carving the vague breadth of native Japanese words into finer pieces.

words.term: 塵も積もれば山となる
words.reading: ちりもつもればやまとなる
words.meaning: many a little makes a mickle
words.defJa: 小さなことも積めば大きくなる

cards.ja: 「塵も積もれば山となる」というが、実際に山の高さまで届くのは、塵を積み続ける人だけである。毎日わずか十分の読書でも、一年続ければ六十時間を超え、新書なら数冊の本を読み終える計算になる。問題は、その十分が三日目に消え、結局何も読まずじまいに終わることだ。千里の道も一歩からと説く諺はどれも、続けることの難しさを裏返しにして、向上心を支える小さな習慣の価値を静かに語っている。
cards.form: 塵も積もれば山となる
cards.en: They say “dust piled up becomes a mountain,” but in reality only the person who keeps piling dust gets a mountain. Even ten minutes of reading a day passes sixty hours in a year, which works out to finishing several books. The problem is that those ten minutes vanish by the third day and, in the end, nothing gets read. Every proverb that preaches a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step speaks of the value of small habits that sustain the drive to improve, by turning the difficulty of persistence inside out.

words.defJa: 国同士が得意な分野を分担すること

cards.ja: 十九世紀、イギリスは工業製品を輸出し、インドや南北アメリカは綿花や穀物などの原料を供給する、という国際分業が形づくられた。各国が得意な分野に特化すれば全体の富は増える反面、原料を輸出する側は価格の変動に翻弄され、工業化の機会を奪われる例も少なくなかった。比較優位の考え方は、この構図を正当化する理論としても使われた。のちの南北問題は、この構造の延長線上に生まれたと言われる。
cards.en: In the nineteenth century, an international division of labor took shape: Britain exported manufactured goods while India and the Americas supplied raw materials such as cotton and grain. While specialization in what each country does best raises total wealth, it was not rare for raw-material exporters to be buffeted by price swings and denied the chance to industrialize. The idea of comparative advantage was also used as a theory to justify this arrangement. The later North-South problem is said to have arisen along the extension of this structure.

cards.tipJa: 「国際分業が進む」のように、貿易で役割を分け合う仕組みを言う
cards.enTarget: In the nineteenth century, an international division of labor took shape: Britain exported manufactured goods while India and the Americas supplied raw materials such as cotton and grain.

words.defJa: 語形変化に乏しく語順などで文法関係を示す言語

cards.ja: 語尾が変わらないというだけで、表現が単純だと決めつけるのは早計である。語の形をほとんど変えず、主に語順や独立した語で文法関係を示す言語の型を、孤立語という。これは文法がないという意味ではなく、語の働きを示す仕組みが異なるということである。外来語の多さや文字の種類から、その仕組みを判断することはできない。言語を比較するにあたっては、品詞の名前を対応させるだけでなく、実際の文で何が誰にどう働きかけているかを確かめる必要がある。
cards.en: It is premature to assume that expression is simple merely because word endings do not change. An isolating language is a type of language that changes word forms very little and expresses grammatical relationships mainly through word order and independent words. This does not mean that it lacks grammar, but that it has a different system for indicating how words function. You cannot identify that system from the number of loanwords or the type of writing used. When comparing languages, we need to do more than match names for parts of speech and examine what acts on whom, and how, in actual sentences.

words.defJa: 天皇を君主または国家の象徴とする制度

cards.ja: 明治の政治を学んだあとで戦後の憲法を読むと、同じ天皇という言葉でも、その役割の違いに戸惑うことがあります。天皇制を理解するにあたっては、地位の名称だけでなく、誰が政治を決め、どのような責任を負うのかを整理するとよいでしょう。明治の国づくりなら、富国強兵という目標と官僚制の整備も視野に入れます。それを戦後の象徴としての地位と区別して、表に並べてみてください。名前の連続性に加えて、権限や制度の変化にも目を向けることが、歴史を理解する手がかりになります。
cards.en: When you read the postwar constitution after studying Meiji politics, the different roles attached to the same word, emperor, can be confusing. To understand the emperor system, it helps to look beyond the title and identify who makes political decisions and bears what responsibilities. For Meiji nation building, include the goal of enriching the country and strengthening its military and the development of a bureaucracy. Distinguish these from the emperor's postwar position as a symbol, and arrange them in a comparison table. Looking at changes in powers and institutions alongside continuity in names provides a key to understanding history.

cards.ja: カタカナの外来語って、実は元の英語と意味がずれてるものが多いじゃないですか。たとえばマンションは、英語だと大邸宅のことですよね。ああいうのは和製英語と呼ばれて、本家には通じないんですよ。カタカナ語を覚えるときは、発音より先に使われ方を疑うに越したことはないです。ちなみに、アルバイトやテーマはドイツ語に由来していて、英語だと思い込んでいる人も意外に多いんですよ。
cards.en: Don't you find that many katakana loanwords actually differ in meaning from the original English? Take mansion, for example: in English it means a grand residence. Words like that are called Japanese-made English, and they don't get across to native speakers. When you learn katakana words, it is best to doubt how they are used before you worry about pronunciation. Incidentally, arubaito and tema come from German, and quite a few people assume they are English.

words.defJa: 自分や物事を第三者の目で見ること

cards.ja: 自分のミスを客観視するのって、意外と難しいんだよね。腹が立ったり落ち込んだりしている最中に、頭の中がその感情でいっぱいだから。そういうときは、ノートに事実だけを書き出して、「他人の失敗だったら何て言うか」を考えてみる。完璧主義の人ほど、この距離の取り方がよく効いて、必要以上に自分を責めずにすむんだよ。距離を置くことで、見えなかった原因や次の一手が、すっと見えてくる。
cards.en: Viewing your own mistakes objectively is surprisingly hard. In the middle of being angry or dejected, your head is full of that emotion. At such times, write down only the facts in a notebook and try thinking about what you would say if it were someone else's failure. For perfectionists especially, this way of taking distance works well and spares them from blaming themselves more than necessary. By putting distance in, causes and next moves you couldn't see come into view smoothly.

words.defJa: 十五〜十七世紀の欧州の海洋進出期

cards.ja: 大航海時代は、冒険心の産物であったと語られることが多い。だが実際には、香辛料交易の仲介を握る勢力を迂回したいという、冷徹な商業的動機が背後にあった。ヨーロッパの船が海へ乗り出した結果、世界は初めて一つの経済圏として結ばれ始める。それは世界を結んだのみならず、のちの奴隷貿易の舞台ともなったのである。冒険家の英雄譚の陰に、地図の空白を市場に変えようとする計算が働いていたことを忘れてはならない。
cards.en: The Age of Discovery is often described as a product of the spirit of adventure. In reality, however, behind it lay a cold commercial motive: the wish to bypass the powers that controlled the brokerage of the spice trade. As a result of European ships setting out to sea, the world began to be linked for the first time as a single economic sphere. It not only tied the world together but also became the stage for the slave trade that followed. We must not forget that behind the heroic tales of adventurers there worked a calculation to turn the blank spaces on the map into markets.

words.defJa: 人を財産として所有し使役する制度

cards.ja: 奴隷制を、遠い過去の野蛮な風習として片づけてしまうのは簡単である。だが実際には、それは綿花や砂糖、煙草といった商品の生産と、金融や保険の仕組みに深く組み込まれた経済制度だった。啓蒙思想が自由を説いたその同じ十八世紀に、大西洋の奴隷貿易は最盛期を迎えていた。その影は、今日に至るまで社会に残り続けている。名目上の廃止と、実質的な解放とのあいだには、長い時間と多くの闘いが横たわっていた。
cards.en: It is easy to dismiss slavery as a barbaric custom of the distant past. In reality, however, it was an economic system deeply built into the production of goods such as cotton, sugar, and tobacco, and into the machinery of finance and insurance. In that very same eighteenth century in which Enlightenment thought preached liberty, the Atlantic slave trade reached its peak. Its shadow continues to remain in society to this day. Between formal abolition and substantive liberation lay a long time and many struggles.

cards.tipJa: 「〜制」は制度を表す。経済や政治の仕組みとして論じる語。
cards.enTarget: It is easy to dismiss slavery as a barbaric custom of the distant past.

words.defJa: 俳句で季節を表す決まりの語

cards.ja: 俳句の季語は、和歌の伝統を受け継いだ約束事ですが、旧暦の名残で今の感覚とずれることがあります。たとえば「七夕」は現在の暦では七月ですが、歳時記では秋に分類されます。旧暦の七月は今の八月ごろにあたり、立秋を過ぎていたからです。こうした例は入試の文学史でも出るので、暦と季節感の両面から覚えておきましょう。鑑賞するときも、その季節を取り違えると、句の情景がまるで違って見えてしまいます。
cards.en: Seasonal words in haiku are conventions that inherit the tradition of waka, but because of lingering traces of the old calendar, they can be out of step with present-day feeling. For example, Tanabata falls in July on the current calendar, but as a seasonal word it is classified as autumn. The seventh month of the old calendar corresponds to about August now, and the start of autumn had already passed. Such examples also appear in literary history on entrance exams, so remember them from both the calendar and the sense of the seasons. When appreciating a poem, too, mistaking its season makes the scene of the verse look entirely different.

words.defJa: 奴隷を売買し運ぶ貿易

cards.ja: 大航海時代の幕開けとともに始まった大西洋の奴隷貿易では、一千万人を超えるアフリカ人が船に積み込まれ、南北アメリカへ運ばれたと推計されている。航海中の過酷な環境で、多くの人が命を落とした。この貿易は、ヨーロッパの港町に莫大な富をもたらす反面、アフリカ西部の社会に深い傷を残した。近年は、関与した都市や企業が過去を調査し、公に検証する動きも広がりつつある。過去の負債にどう向き合うかは、今も解決していない問いである。
cards.en: In the Atlantic slave trade, which began with the dawn of the Age of Discovery, more than ten million Africans are estimated to have been loaded onto ships and carried to the Americas. Many lost their lives in the harsh conditions of the voyage. While this trade brought enormous wealth to European port towns, it left deep wounds in the societies of West Africa. In recent years, cities and companies that were involved have also been investigating the past and examining it publicly, a movement that is spreading. How to face the debts of the past remains an unresolved question.

words.defJa: 広い陸地を基盤とする国家

cards.ja: ロシアや中国のような大陸国家は、陸続きの国境を長く抱え、その安全保障に膨大な資源を割かざるを得ない。これに対し、海洋国家は海を天然の堀として使え、艦隊による通商路の確保に力を集中できる。地政学の古典はこの差を、国家の戦略や気質を決める要因として論じてきた。ただし技術の進歩とともに、陸と海の区別は次第にあいまいになりつつある。海に囲まれた国と、複数の国と接する国とでは、同じ軍備を持っていても、感じる脅威の質が違うのである。
cards.en: Continental powers such as Russia and China have long land borders and cannot avoid devoting vast resources to their security. Maritime states, by contrast, can use the sea as a natural moat and concentrate their strength on securing trade routes with fleets. The classics of geopolitics have discussed this difference as a factor that determines a state's strategy and temperament. With technological progress, however, the distinction between land and sea is gradually becoming blurred. Between a country surrounded by sea and one bordering several countries, the nature of the threat felt differs even when they hold the same armaments.

words.reading: えんきょくひょうげん
words.defJa: 露骨な言い方を避けた遠回しの表現

cards.ja: 「亡くなる」「お手洗い」「お引き取り願う」はみな、露骨な言い方を避けるための婉曲表現です。日本語は特にこの種の表現が発達していて、相手の気持ちを傷つけないことを重んじる文化と結びついています。ただし、遠回しな言い方を重ねすぎると、肝心の意図が伝わらなくなる恐れがあります。試験の読解でも、「検討します」が実は断りだという含意を読み取れるかどうかが問われますよ。逆に、自分が断るときに使える柔らかい言い回しも、一つ持っておくと便利です。
cards.en: Expressions such as nakunaru, otearai, and o-hikitori negau are all euphemisms meant to avoid blunt wording. Japanese is especially rich in this kind of expression, which is tied to a culture that values not hurting the other person's feelings. However, if you pile up euphemisms too much, there is a risk that the essential intent will not get across. Even in exam reading, you will be tested on whether you can read the implication that we'll consider it is actually a refusal. Conversely, it is also handy to have one soft phrase of your own for when you decline.

words.defJa: 官僚による組織的な統治の仕組み

cards.ja: 中国では、隋の時代に始まった科挙が、家柄ではなく試験の成績で官僚を選ぶ道を開いた。名君と称えられる皇帝でも、長きにわたって広い国土を治めるには、官僚制という巨大な装置が欠かせなかった。一方で、試験のための暗記が重視される結果、実務能力とは別の才能が選ばれる弊害も指摘されてきた。この仕組みは朝鮮やベトナムにも伝わり、東アジアの政治文化を形づくった。現代の行政が試験で人を選ぶ原型も、この仕組みに見いだせる。
cards.en: In China, the imperial examinations that began in the Sui era opened a path to choosing officials by exam results rather than by family background. Even emperors praised as wise rulers needed the enormous apparatus of bureaucracy to govern a vast territory over a long period. On the other hand, because memorization for the exams was emphasized, the drawback has also been pointed out that talents unrelated to practical ability were selected. This system spread to Korea and Vietnam as well and shaped the political culture of East Asia. The prototype of modern administration choosing people by examination can be found in this system.

cards.tipJa: 「〜制」は制度。官僚を試験で選ぶ科挙と結びつけて学ぶ。
cards.enTarget: Even emperors praised as wise rulers needed the enormous apparatus of bureaucracy to govern a vast territory over a long period.

words.defJa: 国際連盟が戦勝国に委ねた統治

cards.ja: 第一次世界大戦のあと、ドイツやオスマン帝国の旧領土がどうなったかっていうと、国際連盟が委任統治っていう形で戦勝国に預けたんですよね。名目は「自立できるまでの後見」。でも実際には、戦勝国が宗主国のように振る舞って運営してたんです。パレスチナをはじめ、中東の国境線の多くは、その時期の取り決めに由来しています。その名目と実態のずれが、のちの民族紛争や国境問題の火種になったことは、否定できません。
cards.en: As for what became of the former territories of Germany and the Ottoman Empire after the First World War, the League of Nations entrusted them to the victors in the form of mandates. The stated purpose was guardianship until they could stand on their own. In reality, though, the victors ran them while behaving like colonial rulers. Many of the borders in the Middle East, Palestine among them, derive from agreements of that period. It cannot be denied that the gap between pretext and reality became a source of later ethnic conflicts and border disputes.

words.reading: じっしょうけんきゅう
words.defJa: 実際のデータに基づく研究

cards.ja: ねえ、「朝活は成功の秘訣」って本、よく見るけど、あれって実証研究で裏づけられてるのかな。調べてみたら、朝型の人のほうが成績がいいという結果は確かにあったんだけど、因果関係までは言えてなかったんだよ。もともと自己管理が得意な人が朝型になりやすいだけかもしれない。客観視して読まないと、鵜呑みにしてだまされかねないよね。結局、本の帯の言葉より、元の論文の方法の欄を読むほうが信頼できるんだよ。
cards.en: Hey, you see books saying morning activity is the secret to success all the time, but I wonder if that is backed by empirical research. When I looked into it, there were indeed results showing morning types do better in grades, but they couldn't claim a causal relationship. It may simply be that people who are good at self-management tend to become morning types. If you don't read it objectively, you could swallow it whole and get fooled. In the end, reading the methods section of the original paper is more reliable than the blurb on a book's wrapper.

words.defJa: 良い結果が良い結果を生む循環

cards.ja: 学びがうまく回り始めるとき、そこにはたいてい好循環がある。小さな成功が自信を生み、自信が次の挑戦への意欲を呼び、その挑戦がまた新しい成功を連れてくる。この輪に入れるかどうかは、才能よりも、最初の一歩をどれだけ小さく設計できたかで決まるように思う。逆に、完璧主義の者は最初から大きな目標を掲げ、輪の外で足踏みを余儀なくされる。だから、まず五分だけやってみるという小さな約束から始める価値がある。
cards.en: When learning starts to turn smoothly, there is usually a virtuous circle behind it. A small success breeds confidence, confidence summons the will for the next challenge, and that challenge brings yet another success. Whether you can get into this loop seems to depend less on talent than on how small you managed to design the first step. Conversely, a perfectionist sets a big goal from the start and is forced to mark time outside the loop. So it is worth starting from the small promise of trying just five minutes.

words.defJa: 文章の大まかな意味

cards.ja: 試験の読解ってさ、全部の単語を訳しきれっこないんだから、大意さえつかめれば意外と点が取れるんだよね。むしろ一語ずつ訳してたら、時間が足りなくなるのがオチ。段落の最初と最後だけ先に読んで、言いたいことの見当をつけてから本文に入る人もいる。多読で鍛えた人は、知らない語があっても前後から推測する癖がついてるんだよ。終わってから読み直すと、細かい語を知らなくても解けていた問題の多さに驚くはずだよ。
cards.en: In reading comprehension on exams, you can't possibly translate every word anyway, so you can get surprisingly good scores as long as you catch the gist. If anything, translating one word at a time just ends with you running out of time. Some people read only the start and end of a paragraph first, get a sense of what it's trying to say, and then go into the main text. People trained by extensive reading have the habit of guessing from context even when they meet an unknown word. If you reread after finishing, you will be surprised how many questions you could solve without knowing the fine details of the words.

words.reading: しゅうきょうせんそう
words.defJa: 宗教の違いをめぐる戦争

cards.ja: 十七世紀前半のドイツでは、三十年戦争と呼ばれる大規模な宗教戦争が起き、人口が地域によっては三分の一近く減ったとされる。発端は宗教改革後の旧教と新教の対立だったが、戦いが長引くにつれて、フランスやスウェーデンなど各国の利害が絡み合い、純粋な信仰の争いとは言えなくなった。長い交渉を経て結ばれた一六四八年のウェストファリア条約は、この泥沼に終止符を打った。以後、国家が主権を持つという考え方が、欧州の秩序の土台となっていく。
cards.en: In early seventeenth-century Germany, a large-scale religious war known as the Thirty Years' War broke out, and the population is said to have fallen by nearly a third in some regions. It began as a conflict between Catholics and Protestants after the Reformation, but as the fighting dragged on, the interests of states such as France and Sweden became entangled, and it could no longer be called a purely religious struggle. The Peace of Westphalia of 1648, concluded after long negotiations, put an end to this quagmire. From then on, the idea that states hold sovereignty became the foundation of the European order.

words.defJa: 大脳の表面を覆う灰白質の層

cards.ja: 人間の大脳皮質は、厚さわずか二、三ミリの薄い層でしかない。だが無数の皺を刻むことで、広い面積が狭い頭蓋に収まっている。思考や言語、計画といった高次の働きはこの層に宿るが、それを動かす土台には、はるかに古い脳の部分が控えている。理性は、自らを客観視できる唯一の存在であるかのように見えて、実は深い基盤の上に乗っているにすぎない。人間の知性の座は、驚くほど薄く、しかも折りたたまれた姿で頭の中に収まっているのだ。
cards.en: The human cerebral cortex is only a thin layer, two or three millimeters thick. By carving countless folds, however, a broad surface area fits into a narrow skull. Higher functions such as thought, language, and planning dwell in this layer, but behind what drives them stands a far older part of the brain as a foundation. Reason looks as if it were the only entity able to view itself objectively, but it is in fact merely resting on a deep base. The seat of human intelligence fits inside the head as something astonishingly thin and, moreover, folded up.

cards.tipJa: 脳の表面の層。「大脳皮質が発達する」など、神経科学の基本語。
cards.enTarget: The human cerebral cortex is only a thin layer, two or three millimeters thick.

words.defJa: 脳の損傷で言語機能が損なわれる障害

cards.ja: 脳卒中のあとに起こる失語症には、大きく二つのタイプがあります。話す力が損なわれても理解は保たれるタイプと、流暢に話せるのに意味が通らなくなるタイプです。前者は左半球の前方、後者は後方の大脳皮質の損傷と結びつくことが、十九世紀の研究から分かってきました。言葉を理解する上で、この発見は決定的でした。言葉は一つの塊ではなく、複数の働きの連携として脳に宿っています。
cards.en: Aphasia, which occurs after a stroke, comes in two broad types. In one, the ability to speak is impaired while comprehension is preserved; in the other, one can speak fluently but what is said stops making sense. Research from the nineteenth century has shown that the former is linked to damage in the front of the left hemisphere and the latter to damage in the cerebral cortex at the back. This discovery was decisive for understanding language. Language is not a single lump but dwells in the brain as the coordination of several functions.

cards.enTarget: Aphasia, which occurs after a stroke, comes in two broad types.

words.defJa: 大人物は遅れて才能が開く

cards.ja: 大器晩成という言葉は、遅咲きの者への慰めとして使われがちだが、本来の意味はもう少し厳しい。大きな器は、作るのに時間がかかるばかりか、できあがるまで何の役に立つのかさえ周囲には分からないのである。だからこそ、結果が出ない時期に自分を見限らず、地道な積み重ねを続ける胆力が試される。天賦の才の有無より、待つ力こそが問われているのだ。若いころの目立たなさを嘆くより、器の底を静かに広げているのだと考えるほうが、はるかに建設的だ。
cards.en: The phrase tairi bansei tends to be used as a consolation for late bloomers, but its original meaning is somewhat harsher. A large vessel not only takes time to make, but until it is finished, those around it cannot even tell what use it will be. That is exactly why the nerve to keep up steady effort without giving up on oneself during the period when no results appear is put to the test. What is being asked is not whether one has natural gifts, but the power to wait. Rather than lamenting one's obscurity in youth, it is far more constructive to think of oneself as quietly widening the base of the vessel.

words.defJa: 苦しみの多い現世。刑務所の外の世界

cards.ja: 「娑婆」はサンスクリット語の「サハー」に由来し、仏教では苦しみを耐え忍ぶべき現世を指します。ところが日常語では、刑務所を出た人が「シャバの空気はうまい」と言うように、自由な外の世界という明るい意味へと、時代に伴って変わりました。このように語の含意がほぼ正反対に近くなった例は、試験でも狙われやすいので、由来から整理しておくと得点につながります。ちなみに、仏教語が俗語になった例としては、ほかに「世間」や「方便」なども挙げられます。
cards.en: The word shaba derives from the Sanskrit saha and refers in Buddhism to this present world, where suffering must be endured. In everyday language, however, as when someone released from prison says the air of the outside world is delicious, it has changed over time to the bright sense of the free world outside. Cases like this, where a word's connotation has become nearly the opposite, are easy targets on exams, so sorting them out from their origins will lead to points. Other examples of Buddhist terms that became everyday words include seken and hoben.

words.defJa: 複数の民族から成り立つ国家

cards.ja: インドは、憲法が二十二の言語を公認する多民族国家です。ヒンディー語だけを国語にしようとしたところ、南部の強い反発を招きました。それ以来、中央政府は言語を押しつけるより、周縁の州ごとの自治を認める方へ舵を切ってきました。多様なままで一つにまとまる難しさを、この国ほどよく示している例はありません。同じ言語を話す人々が人口の大半を占める日本のような国とは、政治の課題の質がまるで違います。
cards.en: India is a multiethnic state whose constitution recognizes twenty-two languages. When there was an attempt to make Hindi alone the national language, it provoked fierce opposition in the south. Since then, the central government has steered toward allowing autonomy state by state on the periphery rather than imposing a language. No country shows better than this one how hard it is to hold together while remaining diverse. Its political challenges differ completely in kind from those of a country like Japan, where people who speak the same language make up most of the population.

words.defJa: 完璧を求める態度や考え方

cards.ja: 向上心の表れとして肯定されがちな完璧主義は、近年の心理学研究では、その負の側面にも目が向けられている。失敗を極端に恐れる傾向が強い人ほど、着手を先延ばしにし、燃え尽きを経験しやすいと指摘されている。完璧を求めるあまり、提出が遅れて評価を下げるという皮肉な事態も起きる。「八割で出す」勇気が、結果として成果を押し上げる場面も少なくない。まず粗い草稿を出すことから始めるのが、遠回りに見えて近道である。
cards.en: Perfectionism, which tends to be affirmed as an expression of ambition to improve, has had its negative side turned to as well in recent psychological research. It is pointed out that people with a strong tendency to fear failure extremely are the more likely to procrastinate and to experience burnout. There is even the ironic situation in which, from demanding perfection, one submits late and lowers one's evaluation. Not a few cases exist where the courage to submit at eighty percent ends up pushing results up. Starting by submitting a rough draft looks like a detour but is a shortcut.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「〜主義」は態度や立場を表す。長所と短所の両面が論じられる。
cards.enTarget: Perfectionism, which tends to be affirmed as an expression of ambition to improve, has had its negative side turned to as well in recent psychological research.

words.defJa: 関心が外の世界や他者に向く性格

cards.ja: 在宅勤務が定着した今、外向型の社員ほど孤独を感じやすいという指摘がある。人と会うことで活力を得るタイプにとって、画面越しの会議は刺激が足りないのだという。一方、内向型は集中できる環境を歓迎する反面、雑談の減少で情報から取り残される不安も抱える。働き方の評価は、性格の違いを抜きにして語れない。ただ、どちらが優れているという話ではなく、自分の型を知ったうえで環境を調整することが肝心だ。
cards.en: Now that remote work has taken hold, it is pointed out that extroverted employees are the more prone to loneliness. For an extrovert who draws energy from meeting people, meetings on a screen are said to lack stimulation. Introverts, meanwhile, welcome an environment where they can concentrate, but they also worry about being left out of information as casual chatter declines. Any assessment of working styles cannot be discussed without accounting for differences in personality. Still, the point is not which is superior, but knowing one's own type and then adjusting one's environment.

cards.tipJa: 「内向型」と対になる性格類型。「〜型」で分類する報道調の語。
cards.enTarget: Now that remote work has taken hold, it is pointed out that extroverted employees are the more prone to loneliness.

words.defJa: 同じ宗教の中の教派

cards.ja: 仏教って、宗派によってお経も作法も全然違うんだよね。たいていのお経は呉音で読まれるけど、同じ南無阿弥陀仏でも、浄土宗と浄土真宗では受け止め方が微妙に違うんだって。禅宗になると、そもそも経典に頼るより座ることを重んじる。ひとつの教えが国や時代に応じて多様に枝分かれしていくのは、インド起源の思想ならではだと思う。違いを知っておくと、お寺に行ったときの見え方もぐっと面白くなるよ。
cards.en: In Buddhism, the sutras and the etiquette are completely different depending on the sect. Most sutras are read in the Go-on readings, but even for the same Namu Amida Butsu, I hear the Jodo school and the Jodo Shin school understand it a little differently. When it comes to Zen, they value sitting more than relying on scriptures in the first place. I think it's characteristic of a tradition rooted in India that one teaching branches out in so many ways according to country and era. If you know the differences, how things look when you visit a temple becomes far more interesting.

cards.enTarget: In Buddhism, the sutras and the etiquette are completely different depending on the sect.

words.defJa: 生まれつき備わった優れた才能

cards.ja: 天賦の才があるからといって、練習が要らなくなるわけじゃないよね。プロの演奏家を調べた研究でも、上位の人ほど練習の質と量が段違いだったんだ。才能って、生まれつきというより、あとから貼られるラベルに近い気がする。羨んでる暇があったら、向上心のあるうちに一時間やってみたほうが早いよ。それに、才能があると言われ続けた人ほど、失敗を怖がって新しい挑戦を避けるようになることもあるらしいよ。
cards.en: Having a natural gift doesn't mean practice becomes unnecessary, right? Even in research on professional musicians, the higher-ranked players were far ahead in the quality and quantity of their practice. I feel talent is closer to a label stuck on afterward than to something you're born with. If you have time to be envious, it's faster to try an hour of it while your drive to improve is still alive. Besides, I hear that people who keep being told they have talent sometimes fear failure and start avoiding new challenges.

words.defJa: 本当に存在すること

cards.ja: インド哲学の大きな問いの一つは、この世界は本当にあるのか、というものです。シャンカラの不二一元論では、変化し続けるこの娑婆の世界は、究極の実在である梵が見せる現れにすぎないとされます。たとえば縄を蛇と見間違えるように、私たちは梵の上に世界を重ねて見ているというのです。そう言われても、すぐには受け入れがたいものがありますよね。梵と自己が一つであると悟ることが、解脱の核心とされています。
cards.en: One of the big questions of Indian philosophy is whether this world truly exists. In Shankara's Advaita Vedanta, this ever-changing world of samsara is said to be nothing more than an appearance shown by Brahman, the ultimate reality. Just as one mistakes a rope for a snake, we are said to see the world superimposed on Brahman. Even when told that, there is something hard to accept right away, isn't there? Realizing that Brahman and the self are one is regarded as the core of liberation.

words.defJa: 母音以外の言語音

cards.ja: アナウンサーの滑舌練習では、母音よりも子音の処理に時間をかけます。語頭の音が曖昧だと、言葉の輪郭がぼやけて、聞き手に届く前に溶けてしまうからです。たとえば「さしすせそ」を言うとき、言葉を咀嚼するように一音ずつ、舌先と歯の間の空気の通り道を意識するだけで、鮮明さは一変します。聞き取りやすさを保つ上で決め手になるのは、声の大きさより一音一音の粒立ちです。録音して聞き直せば、音が痩せている箇所はすぐ見つかります。
cards.en: In an announcer's diction practice, more time is spent on handling consonants than vowels. If the consonant at the start of a word is vague, the outline of the word blurs and melts away before it reaches the listener. When saying sa-shi-su-se-so, for instance, just being aware of the airflow channel between the tip of the tongue and the teeth, one sound at a time as if chewing the words, transforms the clarity. What decides how easy you are to understand is the crispness of the consonants, more than the loudness of your voice. If you record yourself and listen back, the spots where the sound is thin are quickly found.

words.defJa: 文字の形

cards.ja: 手書きの文字が読みやすいかどうかは、字形の整い方でほぼ決まる。たとえば「土」と「士」は、縦の線の長さが違うだけで別の字になるため、書き分けを意識しなければならない。偏と旁のバランスをとる、はねや払いを省かない、といった基本を守るだけでも印象は変わる。どんな名文も読みにくい字で書かれては、価値が半減しかねない。練習は、速く書こうとせず、一画ずつゆっくり書くことから始めるのが近道である。
cards.en: Whether handwriting is easy to read is largely decided by how well the letterforms are balanced. For example, the characters for earth and for samurai become different characters merely through the length of a vertical stroke, so you must be conscious of writing them apart. Just following the basics, such as balancing the left and right components and not skipping hooks and sweeps, changes the impression. Even a masterpiece of prose could lose half its value if written in hard-to-read characters. For practice, the shortcut is to start by writing slowly one stroke at a time instead of trying to write fast.

words.defJa: 一か所に住みつくこと

cards.ja: 人類の歴史を大きく変えたのは、定住という選択でした。農耕と家畜化が始まると、人々は収穫を待つために一か所にとどまるようになります。ところが、初期の農耕民は狩猟採集民より栄養状態が悪く、感染症にもかかりやすかったとされています。それでも数千年を通じて集落は都市へと育ちましたが、それは余った食料が分業と文明を支えたからです。つまり人類は、健康を犠牲にして、未来への投資を選んだことになります。
cards.en: What changed human history greatly was the choice of settling down. Once farming and domestication began, people came to stay in one place to wait for the harvest. Yet early farmers are said to have been in worse nutritional condition than hunter-gatherers and more prone to infectious disease. Even so, over several thousand years settlements grew into cities, and that was because surplus food supported the division of labor and civilization. In other words, humanity chose to invest in the future at the expense of health.

cards.enTarget: What changed human history greatly was the choice of settling down.

words.reading: あんぜんほしょうりじかい
words.defJa: 国連で平和維持を担う主要機関

cards.ja: 国連の安全保障理事会は、常任理事国五か国と、任期二年の非常任理事国十か国で構成されています。五つの常任理事国には拒否権があり、一国でも反対すれば決議は成立しません。第二次世界大戦の戦勝国が戦後秩序を管理するために作った仕組みが、今も続いているわけです。多極化が進んだ今、この制度では世界の実態を映せないという声は強い一方、誰の権限を削るのかをめぐって議論は膠着しています。
cards.en: The UN Security Council is made up of five permanent members and ten non-permanent members serving two-year terms. The five permanent members hold a veto, so if even one country objects, a resolution does not pass. The arrangement the victors of the Second World War built to manage the postwar order is still going on today. Now that multipolarization has advanced, voices saying this system cannot reflect the reality of the world are strong, but debate is deadlocked over whose powers would be cut.

words.meaning: return of power to the emperor (1867)
words.defJa: 幕府が政権を朝廷に返したこと

cards.ja: 1867年、第十五代将軍の徳川慶喜は、政権を朝廷に返上する大政奉還を申し出た。武力による衝突を避けつつ、新政権の中でも徳川家の主導権を保とうとする狙いがあったとされる。しかし、討幕を求める勢力は王政復古の大号令でこれを覆し、事態は一年半に及ぶ戊辰戦争へと進んだ。家康以来二百六十年余り続いた幕藩体制は、こうして幕を下ろし、新政府は富国強兵という国家目標を掲げて歩み始めた。
cards.en: In 1867, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, the fifteenth shogun, offered the Taisei Hokan, the return of political power to the imperial court. It is said that his aim was to avoid armed conflict while preserving Tokugawa leadership even within the new government. The forces demanding the overthrow of the shogunate, however, overturned this with the proclamation of the Restoration of Imperial Rule, and events moved on to the Boshin War, which lasted a year and a half. The shogunate system that had lasted more than 260 years since Ieyasu thus came to an end, and the new government set out under the national goal of a rich country and strong army.

words.defJa: 奴隷を法的に自由の身にすること

cards.ja: リンカーンの奴隷解放宣言は、実は法律文書としての性格が強く、名文とは言いがたいと評されてきた。むしろ人の心を動かしたのは、のちのゲティスバーグ演説である。わずか数分で終わるその演説は、短さゆえに一語一語が研ぎ澄まされ、聞き手の記憶に刻まれた。ちなみに、その演説でリンカーンは「人民の、人民による、人民のための政治」と語り、民主主義の核心を一息で示した。話し手が伝えたいことを絞り込む勇気を、この対比は教えてくれる。
cards.en: Lincoln's Emancipation Proclamation has been said to be strongly a legal document and hard to call a masterpiece of prose. What actually moved people's hearts was the later Gettysburg Address. That speech, which ends in a mere few minutes, had each word sharpened by its brevity and was etched into listeners' memories. Incidentally, in that speech Lincoln spoke of government of the people, by the people, for the people, stating the core of democracy in one breath. This contrast teaches us the courage a speaker needs to narrow down what they want to convey.

words.defJa: 事実やデータで確かめて示すこと

cards.ja: レポートで「AIは精度が高い」と書くだけでは、実証にはなりません。同じ条件で複数のモデルを比較し、結果を再現できる形で公開すればこそ、主張に説得力が生まれます。半導体の世界でも、微細化の限界が論じられるたびに、新しい技術が実際に動くことを示すデータが求められてきました。自分の成果を客観視するには、ベンチマークの数字は評価の入口にすぎず、現場での検証の積み重ねが欠かせません。数字を示すときは、条件と出典もあわせて書くのが約束です。
cards.en: Merely writing in a report that AI has high accuracy does not amount to empirical proof. Only when you compare several models under the same conditions and publish the results in a reproducible form does your claim gain persuasiveness. In the semiconductor world too, whenever the limits of miniaturization have been debated, data showing that a new technology actually works has been demanded. To view your own results objectively, benchmark numbers are only the entrance to evaluation, and an accumulation of verification in the field is indispensable. When you give numbers, the convention is to write the conditions and sources together.

words.defJa: 国を富ませ軍事力を強める明治の標語

cards.ja: 明治政府が掲げた富国強兵は、日本史の頻出語ですが、四字の意味だけ覚えても得点にはなりません。重要なのは、富国と強兵が、殖産興業をはじめとする具体的な政策に結びついていた点です。大政奉還のあと、欧米列強に並ぶことが急務とされた背景を、因果関係で説明できるようにしましょう。資料問題では、官僚制の整備や地租改正との関連も問われます。試験前に、政策を「富国」と「強兵」の二列に分けて表にすると、頭が整理されます。
cards.en: The Meiji government's slogan of a rich country and strong army is a frequent term in Japanese history, but memorizing the meaning of the four characters alone will not earn points. What matters is that wealth and military strength were tied to concrete policies, including the promotion of industry. Make sure you can explain, in terms of cause and effect, the background in which catching up with the Western powers was deemed urgent after the return of power to the emperor. In source-based questions, you will also be asked about its connection to the building up of the bureaucracy and the land-tax reform. Before the exam, putting the policies into a table with two columns, wealth and military strength, will organize your head.

words.defJa: 複数の意味をもつ語

cards.ja: 「上がる」のような動詞は、辞書でいくつもの項目に分かれる多義語の典型である。階段を上がる、雨が上がる、成績が上がると、意味が大きく広がるうえ、どれも日常に溶け込んでいる。品詞は同じ動詞でも、組み合わさる名詞が変わるだけで、まったく別の動作に見える。用例を丸ごと覚えない限り、使い分けは身につかないだろう。辞書を引くときも、最初の語釈で満足せず、最後の項目まで目を通す習慣をつけたい。
cards.en: A verb like agaru is a typical polysemous word that splits into many entries in a dictionary. Its sense stretches widely, from going up the stairs to the rain letting up to grades going up, and all of them are woven into daily life. Even though the part of speech is the same verb, a change of the noun it combines with makes it look like an entirely different action. Unless you memorize whole usage examples, you will not master how to tell them apart. When looking up a word, too, it is worth building the habit of reading through to the last entry instead of settling for the first definition.

words.defJa: 英国が築いた世界規模の植民地帝国

cards.ja: 大英帝国って、「日の沈まない帝国」って呼ばれてたじゃないですか。世界中に植民地があったから、どこかは必ず昼間だってことなんですけど。でもあの繁栄は、インドをはじめとする植民地からの富に支えられてたんですよね。お茶の時間の優雅さの裏には、宗主国と植民地のそんな関係が隠れてます。紅茶を飲む習慣だって、元をたどれば、中国との貿易とインドでの茶の栽培が生んだ産物なんですよね。
cards.en: The British Empire used to be called the empire on which the sun never sets, didn't it? Because it had colonies all over the world, it meant that somewhere it was always daytime. But that prosperity was supported by wealth from colonies such as India, wasn't it? Behind the elegance of tea time lies that kind of relationship between colonial ruler and colony. Even the habit of drinking tea, traced back, is a product of trade with China and of tea cultivation in India, isn't it?

words.defJa: 知識が記憶にしっかり残ること

cards.ja: 勉強した内容を定着させるには、一度に詰め込むより、間隔を空けて思い出すほうがずっと効果的です。たとえば今日覚えた単語を、明日、三日後、一週間後と思い出す。この「分散学習」と「想起」の組み合わせは、記憶の研究で最も頑健な発見の一つとされています。逆に、ノートを何度も読み返すだけで、自分の言葉で噛み砕くことなく済ませると、分かった気になるだけで、知識は思ったほど残りません。
cards.en: To get what you studied to stick, it is far more effective to recall it at spaced intervals than to cram it all at once. For instance, you recall the word you learned today tomorrow, three days later, and a week later. This combination of distributed learning and recall is regarded as one of the most robust findings in memory research. Conversely, if you only reread your notes over and over without breaking them down in your own words, you merely feel you understand and the knowledge does not remain as much as you'd expect.

cards.sense: 学習内容が記憶に残ること
cards.enTarget: To get what you studied to stick, it is far more effective to recall it at spaced intervals than to cram it all at once.

words.reading: がいはつてきどうきづけ
words.defJa: 報酬など外部から生じるやる気

cards.ja: ご褒美やテストの点数といった外発的動機づけは、短期的には確かに人を動かします。ところが、報酬が消えた途端にやる気まで消えてしまう、という落とし穴があるんです。ある実験では、絵を描くのが好きだった子どもに賞を与えたところ、その後は自発的に描かなくなったと報告されました。好きこそ物の上手なれと言いますが、そこへ報酬を持ち込むと、好きという芯が揺らぎかねません。最初の一押しには使っても、長く続ける力は内側から育てたいところです。
cards.en: Extrinsic motivation, such as rewards and test scores, does move people in the short term. The pitfall, however, is that the moment the reward disappears, the drive disappears with it. In one experiment, when children who loved drawing were given a prize, they reportedly stopped drawing on their own afterward. They say that what you love, you do well, but bringing a reward into the picture can shake the very core of that love. Use it for the initial push if you like, but the strength to keep going is something you want to grow from within.

words.reading: しゅうきょうかいかく
words.defJa: 十六世紀に始まった教会改革運動

cards.ja: 1517年、マルティン・ルターがヴィッテンベルクで「九十五か条の論題」を発表したことが、宗教改革の引き金になった。きっかけは、免罪符の販売をめぐる批判だった。その主張は、印刷術の普及に乗って、数週間のうちにドイツ各地に広まったとされる。聖書が各国語に翻訳され、個人が自分で読んで判断する習慣が広まったことは、のちの啓蒙思想の土壌にもなったと考えられている。こうして一つの宗教運動が、政治や出版、教育のあり方までも変えていった。
cards.en: In 1517, Martin Luther's publication of the Ninety-five Theses at Wittenberg became the trigger of the Reformation. What set it off was criticism over the sale of indulgences. His claims spread across German lands within weeks, riding on the spread of printing, it is said. The translation of the Bible into national languages and the spread of the habit of reading and judging for oneself are thought to have become a seedbed for the later Enlightenment. In this way a single religious movement went on to change even politics, publishing, and education.

words.defJa: 相手の要求を譲って争いを避ける政策

cards.ja: 「宥和政策」という言葉は、いまでは弱腰の代名詞のように使われる。だが一九三八年のミュンヘン会談の時点では、イギリスのチェンバレン首相の判断は、戦争を避けたい多くの人々に支持されていた。一語に後世の評価が染みつくと、当時の文脈が見えなくなる。歴史を語る者は、言葉の含意が時代とともに変わることを、常に意識しておきたい。実際、その後の戦争の経過を知る私たちは、結果から原因を裁きがちである。
cards.en: The term appeasement policy is now used almost as a byword for weak-kneed behavior. But at the time of the 1938 Munich Conference, the judgment of Britain's Prime Minister Chamberlain was supported by many people who wanted to avoid war. Once later generations' verdicts cling to a single word, the context of the time can no longer be seen. Those who speak of history should always be aware that the implications of words change with the times. Indeed, we who know how the war later unfolded tend to judge causes from outcomes.

words.defJa: 修行などを通じて到達した心の段階

cards.ja: 不二一元の境地とは、知識として理解するものではなく、世界の実在と自己との隔たりが消える体験を指す。そこに至った人は、喧騒のただなかにありながらも、湖面のような静けさを失わないという。ところが、そこを目指して力めば力むほど、かえって遠ざかるのが修行の皮肉だ。到達しようとする心こそが、最後の障害になる。実際、禅の問答にも、言葉で示そうとした瞬間にその本質が逃げてしまう、という話が数多く残されている。
cards.en: Nondual realization is not something to be understood as knowledge; it refers to the experience in which the gap between the real world and the self vanishes. Those who have reached that state are said to keep a lakelike calm even amid the clamor. Yet the irony of practice is that the harder you strive for it, the further it recedes. The very mind that tries to arrive is the last obstacle. Indeed, Zen dialogues preserve many tales in which the essence slips away the moment one tries to express it in words.

words.defJa: 動植物を人の管理下で飼い慣らすこと

cards.ja: 犬は最も早く家畜化された動物とされ、その時期は一万五千年以上前にさかのぼるという説がある。農耕や定住に先立って、人は狼の仲間を手なずけ、狩りの相棒にしていたのである。この過程を語るときは、人間が一方的に支配したのではなく、動物の側にも人に近づく利点があったことを添えると、説明に奥行きが出る。共生の歴史を語るとき、その一言が伝え方の質を変える。その相棒関係が、のちの牧畜や農耕の発達にも結びついたと考えられている。
cards.en: The dog is regarded as the earliest domesticated animal, and there is a theory that the time goes back more than fifteen thousand years. Before farming and settlement, humans had tamed relatives of the wolf and made them partners in hunting. When you speak of this process, adding that it was not humans dominating one-sidedly but that the animals too had an advantage in approaching people gives your explanation depth. When telling the history of coexistence, that one remark changes the quality of how it comes across. That partnership is thought to have connected to the later development of herding and farming.

words.defJa: 宗派の違いによる争い

cards.ja: 紛争を報じる記事で「宗派対立」という言葉を安易に使うと、原因は宗教だという含意が生まれ、実態を単純化しかねない。たとえばイラクの内戦では、信仰の違いだけでなく、権力や資源の配分、外国勢力の介入が複雑に絡んでいた。書き手は、対立を宗教で一括りにする前に、利害の構造を丁寧にほぐす必要がある。言葉を選ぶ責任は、事実を調べる責任と同じ重さを持つのである。見出しの一語を決める前に、現場で何が起きていたのかを一度書き出してみるとよい。
cards.en: Using the word sectarian conflict carelessly in an article reporting a conflict creates the implication that the cause is religion and risks oversimplifying reality. In the Iraqi civil war, for example, not only differences of faith but also the distribution of power and resources and the intervention of foreign forces were intricately entangled. Before lumping a conflict together as religion, a writer needs to carefully untangle the structure of interests. The responsibility of choosing words carries the same weight as the responsibility of checking the facts. Before settling on the one word of a headline, it helps to write out once what was actually happening on the ground.

words.defJa: 変化の背後にある独立した本体

cards.ja: 龍樹の「空」の思想は、あらゆるものが独立した実体を持たず、他との関係の中でのみ成り立つと説く。この考えは、仏教内部の実在論的な傾向を根本から問い直すものとして、インド哲学史上、大きな転換点となった。現代の物理学者や認知科学者が、この議論に関心を寄せる例も出てきている。その影響は、東アジアの禅に至るまで及んでいる。この発想は、自分という固定した本体はどこにもないという教えにも直結している。
cards.en: Nagarjuna's idea of emptiness teaches that nothing has an independent substance and everything is established only in relation to others. This idea became a major turning point in the history of Indian philosophy, as something that fundamentally questioned the realist tendencies within Buddhism. There have also been cases of modern physicists and cognitive scientists taking an interest in this argument. Its influence extends all the way to Zen in East Asia. This idea connects directly to the teaching that there is no fixed self anywhere.

cards.enTarget: Nagarjuna's idea of emptiness teaches that nothing has an independent substance and everything is established only in relation to others.

words.defJa: 従属国や植民地を支配する国

cards.ja: 独立後も、旧植民地は宗主国との間に言語や経済の面で深いつながりを残すことが多い。たとえばアフリカ西部のいくつかの国では、フランス語が公用語であり続け、通貨もフランスと結びついた仕組みを使っている。大英帝国の旧領でも、英語が行政や教育の共通語として残った例は多い。こうした関係は、安定をもたらすという評価がある反面、真の自立を妨げているという批判も根強い。旧植民地側の若い世代には、自国の言葉を取り戻そうとする動きも広がっている。
cards.en: Even after independence, former colonies often retain deep ties with their suzerain in language and economy. In several West African countries, for example, French remains an official language, and the currency uses a mechanism tied to France. In the former territories of the British Empire as well, there are many cases where English remained as the common language of administration and education. Such relationships are rated as bringing stability, but on the other hand criticism that they hinder true independence is deep-rooted too. Among the younger generation in former colonies, a movement to reclaim their own languages is also spreading.

cards.enTarget: Even after independence, former colonies often retain deep ties with their suzerain in language and economy.

words.term: 好きこそ物の上手なれ
words.reading: すきこそもののじょうずなれ
words.meaning: what one loves, one does well
words.defJa: 好きなことは自然に上達する

cards.ja: 「好きこそ物の上手なれ」ということわざを、教育心理学の知見が裏づけつつある。自ら選んだ課題に取り組んだ生徒は、与えられた課題の場合に比べ、学習への持続力が高い傾向を示すとされる。ただし、好きだからといって、成果が自動的に保証されるわけではない。好奇心を技能に変えるには、適度に難しい課題と、振り返りの習慣が欠かせないと専門家は指摘する。本人が楽しんでいるあいだは、外発的動機づけに頼らずとも、練習の苦労さえ苦労と感じにくいのも、その一因だろう。
cards.form: 好きこそ物の上手なれ
cards.en: Findings in educational psychology are increasingly backing up the proverb that what you love, you do well. Students who tackled tasks they chose themselves are said to show higher persistence in learning than when tasks were assigned to them. However, liking something does not mean results are automatically guaranteed. Experts point out that turning curiosity into skill requires moderately difficult tasks and the habit of reflection. Part of the reason is probably that while people are enjoying themselves, even without relying on extrinsic motivation, even the hardship of practice hardly feels like hardship.

words.defJa: 権力が複数の極に分散すること

cards.ja: 冷戦後の一極支配が揺らぎ、国際秩序の多極化が進みつつある。新興国が経済力を背景に発言力を強める一方で、既存の大国は同盟の再編を迫られている。安全保障の枠組みも、二国間の取り決めだけでは立ち行かなくなってきた。各国は理念よりも利害に基づいて、その都度、組む相手を選ぶ傾向にある。とはいえ、極が増えるほど意思決定は複雑になり、危機の際に誰が調整役を担うのかも見えにくくなっている。
cards.en: After the Cold War, unipolar dominance has wavered and the multipolarization of the international order is advancing. While emerging powers gain a stronger voice on the back of economic strength, established powers are being pressed to realign their alliances. Security arrangements, too, have stopped working with bilateral agreements alone. Countries tend to choose their partners case by case, based on interests rather than ideals. That said, as poles multiply, decision-making grows more complex, and it is harder to see who will act as coordinator in a crisis.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「〜化」で変化を表す。「多極化が進む」が典型で、国際政治の報道に多い。
cards.enTarget: After the Cold War, unipolar dominance has wavered and the multipolarization of the international order is advancing.

words.defJa: 国家や国民の安全を守ること

cards.ja: 安全保障の考え方は、軍事力の均衡だけでは語れなくなっている。エネルギーや食料、半導体のような重要物資の供給網が途絶えれば、戦火を交えずとも国は立ち行かなくなるからだ。各国が経済と防衛を結びつけて政策を組み立てるようになったのは、この危機感に基づいている。多極化する国際環境のもとでは、貿易や投資の判断までが、外交上の駆け引きの一部となりつつある。従来の外交と産業政策の境目は、いまやほとんど見えなくなっている。
cards.en: The idea of security can no longer be discussed in terms of the balance of military power alone. If the supply chains for critical goods such as energy, food, and semiconductors are cut, a country can no longer function even without a shot being fired. The fact that countries have come to build policy by linking the economy with defense is based on this sense of crisis. In a multipolarizing international environment, even decisions on trade and investment are becoming part of diplomatic maneuvering. The boundary between traditional diplomacy and industrial policy has now become almost invisible.

words.defJa: なすべきことをせず怠けているさま

cards.ja: 机に向かわず動画ばかり見ている自分を、怠惰な人間だと責めてしまうことはありませんか。けれども、予定どおりに勉強できなかったからといって、意志力の弱さだけが原因だと決めつけるのは早いですよね。取りかかる課題が曖昧だったのか、疲れていたのか、その日の状況を一つずつ確かめてみてください。性格の問題だという思い込みをいったん脇に置けば、机に本を出しておくなど、具体的に変えられる点も探せます。自分を裁く言葉を増やすより、明日の最初の一歩を小さく決めておきましょう。
cards.en: Do you ever call yourself a lazy person for watching videos instead of sitting down at your desk? But just because you failed to study as planned, it is too early to decide that weak willpower was the only cause. Check the circumstances of that day one by one, such as whether the task was unclear or you were tired. If you set aside the assumption that your personality is the problem, you can also look for concrete things to change, such as putting a book on your desk. Instead of finding more words to judge yourself with, decide on a small first step for tomorrow.

words.defJa: 記憶を思い出すこと

cards.ja: 記憶の研究では、覚える作業よりも、思い出す作業のほうが学習に効くことが分かってきた。教科書を読み返すより、白紙に何も見ずに書き出す想起の練習のほうが、数日後の成績が高かったという実験結果が複数ある。努力しているという手応えは、読み返しのほうが強い。だが、その感覚こそが錯覚であり、思い込みにすぎないと研究者は警告する。試験前に問題集を何度も解き直す学習法が有効なのも、突き詰めれば、思い出す負荷が記憶を強めるからだと考えられている。
cards.en: Research on memory has found that the act of recalling does more for learning than the act of memorizing. Several experiments show that practice in retrieval, writing out from a blank sheet without looking, led to higher scores days later than rereading the textbook. The sense of having worked hard is stronger with rereading. But researchers warn that this very feeling is an illusion, nothing more than a preconception. That the study method of redoing a problem book several times before an exam is effective is also thought, at bottom, to be because the burden of retrieval strengthens memory.

words.defJa: 気持ちにゆとりがあること

cards.ja: 最近さ、仕事が詰まってくると、まず心の余裕がなくなるじゃないですか。そうするとメールの返信まで冷たくなってしまうものだから、あとで自分でも読み返して嫌になるんですよ。だから私は、予定を入れすぎないって決めたんです。空白の三十分があるだけで、急がば回れって言葉の意味が、身に染みるようになりました。この前なんて、友人の話を聞きながら、頭の中では別の締め切りを数えていて、我ながらひどいと思いました。
cards.en: Lately, when work piles up, the first thing I lose is my peace of mind, you know? Then even my email replies turn cold, so when I reread them later I end up hating myself. That's why I decided not to overbook my schedule. With just a blank half hour, the saying "more haste, less speed" has started to sink in. The other day I was counting another deadline in my head while listening to a friend, and I thought it was awful of me.

words.defJa: 状況をあらかじめ仮に決めること

cards.ja: 半導体工場の建設計画は、需要の見通しが外れると、巨額の損失に直結する。生成AI向けの需要が想定を上回ったため、予定していた生産ラインの増設を前倒しした企業もある。一方で、スマートフォン向けの需要が伸び悩めば、設備が遊休化するおそれもある。投資判断の難しさは、先を読む精度よりも、外れたときに耐えられる余力にかかっている。だからこそ、経営者は最良のシナリオだけでなく、最悪の場合の資金繰りまで描いておかなければならない。
cards.en: A semiconductor plant construction plan leads directly to enormous losses if the demand outlook turns out wrong. Because demand for generative AI exceeded assumptions, some companies brought forward the expansion of production lines they had planned. On the other hand, if demand for smartphones stalls, there is a risk that equipment will sit idle. The difficulty of investment decisions lies less in the accuracy of forecasting than in the reserve strength to withstand being wrong. That is why executives must sketch not only the best scenario but even the cash flow in the worst case.

words.defJa: 弱点を狙って行う質の高い練習

cards.ja: プロのバイオリニストを調べた研究によると、上達を左右したのは、練習の総時間よりも、その中身だった。すでにできる曲を弾き通すのではなく、弱点を見つけて少し難しい課題に取り組む、意図的な練習が積み重ねられていたのである。この知見は「一万時間の法則」として広まったが、提唱者のエリクソン自身は、単純な時間の目安として使われることに異を唱えた。ただ、それを続けるには、意志力だけでなく環境の工夫も欠かせない。
cards.en: According to research on professional violinists, what determined improvement was the content of practice, more than its total hours. They were accumulating deliberate practice: not playing through pieces they could already do but finding weaknesses and taking on slightly harder tasks. This finding spread as the "ten-thousand-hour rule," but Ericsson himself, the originator, objected to its use as a simple measure of time. Still, keeping it up requires not only willpower but ingenuity in the environment.

words.defJa: 律と令に基づく古代の法制度

cards.ja: 奈良の平城京跡から出土する木簡は、八世紀の日本が律令という法の網で社会を運営していた証拠である。戸籍をつくり、田を与え、収穫の一部を租として納めさせる。この仕組みは唐の制度を手本にしたものだが、そのまま移植できたわけではなく、貴族の既得権との折り合いが絶えず問題になった。徴税の現場では、役人の裁量に頼らざるを得なかった地域も多い。この制度の骨格は、のちの日本の官僚制にも長く影を落とした。
cards.en: Wooden tablets unearthed from the Heijō-kyō site in Nara are proof that eighth-century Japan ran its society within the web of law known as ritsuryō. Households were registered, fields were allotted, and part of each harvest was collected as tax. The system was modeled on Tang institutions, but it could not simply be transplanted, and reconciling it with the entrenched interests of the aristocracy was a constant problem. In the actual work of tax collection, there were also many regions where the authorities had no choice but to rely on the discretion of officials. The skeleton of this system cast a long shadow over Japan's later bureaucracy as well.

words.defJa: 根拠なく決めてかかること

cards.ja: 「自分は数学が苦手だ」という思い込みは、実は成績そのものよりも、問題に取りかかる前の姿勢を左右します。ある実験では、同じ難しさの課題でも、「これは苦手な人にはできない」と伝えられた生徒のほうが、早く諦める傾向がありました。能力の差というより、解釈の差が行動を分けているのです。まずは自分がどんな想定で動いているのかを書き出し、一つずつ疑ってみてください。それに気づくだけでも、挑戦の最初の一歩はずっと軽くなります。
cards.en: The belief that "I'm bad at math" actually affects not so much your grades themselves as your attitude before you even start on a problem. In one experiment, even on tasks of equal difficulty, students who were told "people who are bad at this can't do it" tended to give up sooner. Rather than a difference in ability, it is a difference in interpretation that sets behavior apart. First, write down what assumptions you are operating on, and doubt them one by one. Just noticing it makes the first step of any challenge much lighter.

cards.enTarget: The belief that "I'm bad at math" actually affects not so much your grades themselves as your attitude before you even start on a problem.

words.defJa: 身についてしまった悪い習慣

cards.ja: 悪習は、断とうと意気込んだ日に限って、いっそう強く顔を出す。夜更かしでも間食でも、その背後には、不安や退屈を手早くなだめてくれるという報酬が隠れているからだ。意志薄弱を責めても効果は薄く、むしろ同じ報酬をより害の少ない行動で得られるよう置き換えるほうが長続きする。習慣は敵ではなく、満たされない欲求がたどった最短の道なのである。たとえば、夜の間食をやめたいなら、ひとまず手の届く場所に置かないことから始めるとよい。
cards.en: A bad habit shows its face all the more strongly on precisely the day you resolve to break it. Whether it is staying up late or snacking, behind it hides the reward of quickly soothing anxiety or boredom. Blaming weak will has little effect; it lasts longer to substitute a less harmful behavior that gets you the same reward. A habit is not an enemy but the shortest path an unmet need has taken. If you want to stop late-night snacking, for instance, it is good to start by not keeping food within reach.

cards.enTarget: A bad habit shows its face all the more strongly on precisely the day you resolve to break it.

words.defJa: 本来と違う悪い目的で使うこと

cards.ja: 新しい技術を紹介するときは、便利さだけでなく悪用の可能性にも一言触れておくと、話の信頼度がぐっと上がります。たとえば音声合成なら、読み上げの利便性に加えて、声を偽装した詐欺の危険を挙げるのです。リスクを想定して語る人は、誠実だと受け取られます。ただし、不安をあおる言い方にならないよう、対策や心構えもセットで伝えることが大切です。技術そのものに善悪はなく、使い手の意図が結果を決めるという前置きも効果的です。
cards.en: When you introduce a new technology, mentioning not only its convenience but the possibility of its misuse in a word or two sharply raises the credibility of what you say. For speech synthesis, for example, you cite the danger of fraud with a disguised voice in addition to the convenience of reading aloud. People who speak while anticipating risks are taken to be sincere. But so as not to come across as stoking anxiety, it is important to convey countermeasures and the right mindset as a set. A preface that the technology itself is neither good nor bad and that the user's intent determines the outcome is also effective.

src.site: 書き下ろし（このデッキ用）

cards.tipJa: 「悪用する」「悪用を防ぐ」。「乱用」は度を越して使うこと。
cards.enTarget: When you introduce a new technology, mentioning not only its convenience but the possibility of its misuse in a word or two sharply raises the credibility of what you say.

words.defJa: 恐怖で人を従わせる政治

cards.ja: 歴史を語るとき、年号の暗記だけでは聞き手の心は動きません。たとえばフランス革命なら、ロベスピエールが主導した恐怖政治の時代を、断頭台に送られた人数ではなく、隣人を疑うようになった市民の日常から語り始めます。数字は後から添え、まず情景描写から入るのがコツです。聞き手の感覚に訴えればこそ、出来事の重さは自分のものとして受け止められるのです。数字や年号は、情景を支える補助線にすぎないのです。
cards.en: When you speak about history, memorizing dates alone will not move your listeners. For the French Revolution, for example, you begin the story of the Reign of Terror that Robespierre led not with the number sent to the guillotine but with the daily life of citizens who had come to suspect their neighbors. Add the figures afterward, and the trick is to start with a description of the scene. Only by appealing to the listener's senses can the weight of events be received as their own. Numbers and dates are merely auxiliary lines that support the scene.

cards.enTarget: For the French Revolution, for example, you begin the story of the Reign of Terror that Robespierre led not with the number sent to the guillotine but with the daily life of citizens who had come to suspect their neighbors.

words.defJa: 物事を悪い方に見る考え方

cards.ja: 私、昔から悲観主義なんですよ。旅行の前日になると、飛行機が飛ばなかったらどうしようとか、財布を落としたらどうしようとか、ぜんぶ考えずにはいられないんです。でも、それって準備してるってことじゃないですか。実際、最悪を想定しておいたおかげで、大抵のトラブルは慌てずに済むんですよね。友だちには「心配しすぎだよ」って笑われるんですけど、現地で慌てる彼らを横目に、私は予備の充電器を出すんです。
cards.en: I've been a pessimist ever since I was young. The day before a trip, I can't help thinking through everything, like what if the plane doesn't fly, or what if I drop my wallet. But isn't that just preparing? In fact, thanks to having assumed the worst in advance, I can get through most troubles without panicking. My friends laugh and say I worry too much, but while they scramble on arrival, I'm the one pulling out a spare charger.

words.defJa: 物事を深く感じ取る力

cards.ja: 感受性は、傷つきやすさと紙一重である。他人の表情の微かな翳りに気づき、深く感情移入できる人は、同じ理由で、自分に向けられた何気ない一言にも深く揺さぶられる。それを弱さと呼んで矯正しようとするのは、鋭いセンサーの感度を、鈍くして安心するようなものだ。むしろ、その感度をどう使うかという技術こそが、芸術家にも看護師にも求められているのである。ただし、感度を下げずに身を守るには、安心して話せる相手や場所が要る。
cards.en: Sensitivity is separated from vulnerability by a hair. A person who notices the faint shadow in another's expression and can empathize deeply is, for the same reason, deeply shaken even by an offhand remark aimed at them. Calling it weakness and trying to correct it is like dulling a sharp sensor's sensitivity for the sake of peace of mind. Rather, it is the skill of how to use that sensitivity that is demanded of artists and nurses alike. However, to protect oneself without lowering that sensitivity, one needs someone and somewhere safe to talk to.

words.defJa: 心と体が感じる満足や楽しみ

cards.ja: 話に説得力を持たせたいなら、聞き手が得られる快楽を、先に具体的な場面で描いてみるといい。「健康になれます」と言うより、「朝、階段を駆け上がっても息が切れない」と言ったほうが、はるかに伝わる。人は理屈で納得する前に、頭の中で想像した場面で感情の起伏を味わうものだからである。ただし、約束しすぎれば信頼を失うので、盛りすぎないことが肝心だ。数字や理屈は、その場面を支える脇役にすぎない。
cards.en: If you want your talk to be persuasive, try first depicting the pleasure your listener will gain in a concrete scene. Saying "you'll climb the stairs in the morning at a run and not be out of breath" gets across far better than saying "you'll become healthy." This is because, before people are convinced by reasoning, they savor the ups and downs of emotion in a scene they imagine in their heads. But if you promise too much you lose trust, so it is vital not to oversell. Figures and reasoning are merely supporting players for that scene.

cards.enTarget: If you want your talk to be persuasive, try first depicting the pleasure your listener will gain in a concrete scene.

words.defJa: 内に秘めた考えやねらい

cards.ja: 先端の半導体をめぐる各国の動きには、技術の問題だけでは説明できない思惑が絡んでいる。輸出規制は安全保障のためだと説明されるが、同時に自国の産業を守る狙いも透けて見える。他方、規制を受ける側は、代替の調達先を探し、国内生産の拡大を急務と位置づける。こうした応酬が続けば、市場経済の効率よりも、供給の確実さが優先される時代が長引くことになるだろう。いずれの側も、公式の発表と本音とが一致しているとは限らない。
cards.en: Behind the moves of various countries over cutting-edge semiconductors are calculations that cannot be explained by technology alone. Export controls are explained as being for national security, but an aim of protecting one's own industry also shows through. Meanwhile, the side subject to the controls looks for alternative suppliers and treats expanding domestic production as an urgent task. If such tit-for-tat continues, an era in which certainty of supply takes priority over the efficiency of the market economy is likely to drag on. On either side, the official announcement and the real intention do not always match.

words.defJa: 物事を決めること

cards.ja: 人は自分の意思決定を、合理的な比較の結果だと信じている。ところが実際には、直感が先に結論を出し、理屈はあとからそれを正当化しているにすぎない場合が多い。この事実は不愉快だが、目をそらすわけにはいかない。重要な判断を下す者ほど、自分の思い込みがどこに潜んでいるかを疑い、反対意見に耳を傾ける習慣を持つべきである。会議で最も声の大きい人の意見が通ってしまうのも、そうした自己正当化の延長にすぎないのかもしれない。
cards.en: People believe their own decision-making is the result of a rational comparison. In reality, though, intuition often reaches the conclusion first, and reasoning merely justifies it afterward. This fact is unpleasant, but we cannot avert our eyes from it. The more important the judgments someone makes, the more they should doubt where their own preconceptions lurk and form the habit of lending an ear to opposing views. That the opinion of the loudest person in a meeting prevails may be no more than an extension of that self-justification.

If you put "I'd even borrow a cat's paw" straight into English, the other person wouldn't know what it's about. So you swap in the sense of "I just want more hands," but to that extent the original humor vanishes. Having no choice but to make up for that is where a translator shows their skill, and I think communication between different languages is, in the end, that kind of work.

words.defJa: わずかなちがい

cards.ja: 模試で偏差値が2上がったと喜ぶ生徒がいますが、その微差は測定の誤差の範囲にすぎないことが多いのです。本当に実力が伸びたかどうかは、数回分の結果を並べて見なければ判断できません。一回ごとの点数に一喜一憂するという惰性を断ち、間違えた問題の傾向をノートにまとめるほうが、よほど次の成績につながります。数字は目安であって、あなた自身の価値ではありません。ちなみに、満点を狙うより、苦手分野を一つ潰すほうが効率は上がります。
cards.en: Some students are delighted when their deviation score in a mock exam goes up by two, but that slight difference is often well within the margin of measurement error. You cannot tell whether your ability has truly grown without lining up the results of several sittings. Breaking the habit of swinging between joy and gloom over each score and instead summarizing the pattern of the problems you got wrong in a notebook leads far more reliably to your next result. The numbers are a rough guide, not your worth as a person. Incidentally, knocking out one weak area is more efficient than aiming for a perfect score.

words.defJa: 他人の気持ちに自分を重ねること

cards.ja: 小説を読んでいて、登場人物の痛みが自分のことのように感じられることがある。この感情移入は、単なる同情とは違い、相手の立場に自分を置き直す想像力の働きである。ところが、移入が深すぎると、感受性の強い人ほど自分の感情と他人の感情の境目が曖昧になり、心がすり減る。援助職の人々が、共感しつつも一定の距離を保つ訓練を受けるのは、そのためにほかならない。読書が人を優しくするといわれるのは、この働きを日々鍛えているからかもしれない。
cards.en: When reading a novel, there are times when a character's pain feels like your own. This emotional involvement, unlike mere sympathy, is the work of imagination that puts yourself back into the other's position. But if the involvement runs too deep, the more sensitive a person is, the more the boundary between their own feelings and others' blurs, and the heart wears down. This is precisely why people in helping professions are trained to empathize while keeping a certain distance. Reading is said to make people kinder perhaps because it trains this faculty every day.

words.defJa: 心と体

cards.ja: 試験前に徹夜を重ねると、集中力が落ちるだけでなく、心身ともに疲れ切って本番で力を出せなくなります。忘却曲線が示すように、記憶は放っておけば薄れていきますが、眠っている間に整理される部分も大きいのです。とはいえ、不安のあまり眠れない夜もあるでしょう。そんなときは無理に寝ようとせず、軽い散歩で体をほぐすのも一案です。ちなみに、前日に一度だけ早く寝るよりも、一週間かけて少しずつ生活リズムを整えるほうが効果的です。
cards.en: If you pile up all-nighters before an exam, not only does your concentration drop, but you end up exhausted in mind and body and cannot perform on the day. As the forgetting curve shows, memory fades if left alone, but a good part of it is also sorted out while you sleep. That said, there will be nights when you cannot sleep for anxiety. At such times, don't force yourself to sleep; loosening up your body with a light walk is also an option. Incidentally, adjusting your daily rhythm gradually over a week is more effective than going to bed early just once the day before.

words.defJa: 内部の状態を一定に保つ性質

cards.ja: 人の体温は、真夏の屋外でも真冬の室内でも、おおむね三十六度台に保たれている。この働きは恒常性、すなわちホメオスタシスと呼ばれ、発汗や震えといった反応によって支えられている。近年は、この考え方が情動にも当てはまるのではないかとして、研究者の関心を集めている。強いストレスにさらされた後、人が時間とともに平静を取り戻すのも、心身が元の状態へ戻ろうとする力が働くからだという。
cards.en: A person's body temperature is kept roughly in the mid-thirties Celsius, whether outdoors in midsummer or indoors in midwinter. This function is called constancy, or homeostasis, and is supported by reactions such as sweating and shivering. In recent years, this idea has drawn researchers' interest as possibly applying to emotion as well. The fact that people regain their composure over time after intense stress is also said to be because a force works to return mind and body to their original state.

words.defJa: 税を取り立てること

cards.ja: 国家とは何かと問われれば、突き詰めて徴税する力を持つ組織だと答えることもできる。中世の王たちは、軍を養うために諸侯や都市と交渉を重ね、そのたびに議会という妥協の場が育っていった。取り立てる側に正統性がなければ、人々は払うことを拒み、小作人は逃げ、村は荒れる。税をめぐる争いは、いつの時代も権力の性格をあらわにする鏡であった。近代国家が戸籍や統計を整えたのも、突き詰めれば税を取りこぼさないためだった。
cards.en: Asked what a state is, one could answer, at bottom, that it is an organization with the power of tax collection. Medieval kings repeatedly bargained with lords and cities in order to feed their armies, and each time the assemblies we call parliaments, places of compromise, grew up. If the side doing the collecting lacks legitimacy, people refuse to pay, tenant farmers flee, and villages fall into ruin. Struggles over taxes have always been a mirror that lays bare the character of power. The reason modern states built up household registers and statistics was, at bottom, to avoid missing any tax.

cards.en: At sites that accept foreign workers, what is cited as the biggest challenge is communication. Even if people have passed the Japanese-language proficiency test, the instructions flying around the workplace tend to be a distinctive way of speaking that makes heavy use of omissions and jargon. The Japanese side needs to realize that "do it properly" does not convey what to do and how far. Along with placing interpreters, efforts to rephrase the instructions themselves in concrete words are spreading.

words.defJa: 強い衝撃で心に残る傷

cards.ja: 災害から何年もたってから、突然の物音に体が固まる人がいる。心的外傷は、体験そのものの大きさだけでなく、その後に安心できる場所があったかどうかにも左右される。専門家は、当事者に無理に語らせるのではなく、まず日常の安全を取り戻すことが先決だと指摘する。回復には、情動の波と付き合いながら、長い時間をかけて整理していく過程が欠かせない。周囲が「もう終わったことだ」と切り捨ててしまうのも、回復を遅らせる一因になる。
cards.en: Years after a disaster, there are people whose bodies freeze at a sudden noise. Psychological trauma depends not only on the magnitude of the experience itself but also on whether there was a place to feel safe afterward. Specialists point out that rather than forcing those affected to talk, restoring everyday safety must come first. Recovery requires a process of living with the waves of emotion and sorting things out over a long time. When those around them dismiss it with "that's all over now," that too becomes a factor delaying recovery.

Still, with a sweet right in front of him he can't help reaching for it, which made me laugh and think he's still just three.

words.defJa: 心理学を専門とする学者

cards.ja: アメリカの心理学者、カール・ロジャースは、相手を評価せずにただ聞くことが人を変える力になると考えました。彼のカウンセリングでは、助言よりも傾聴が中心に置かれます。これは当時の主流だった「専門家が答えを与える」という発想に反するものでした。日本の学校や職場にも、この考え方は意思疎通の基本として広く浸透しています。また、ロジャースは研究にも録音を取り入れ、面接の内容を第三者が検証できるようにしました。
cards.en: The American psychologist Carl Rogers believed that simply listening, without judging the other person, could become a force that changes people. In his counseling, listening takes center stage over advice. This ran counter to the then-dominant notion that the expert supplies the answer. In Japanese schools and workplaces too, this idea has spread widely as a basis of mutual understanding. Rogers also brought recordings into his research so that third parties could examine the content of the sessions.

words.defJa: これまでのやり方をただ続ける勢い

cards.ja: 勉強が続かない人の多くは、意志力が弱いのではなく、やり方が惰性に流れているだけです。同じ参考書を同じ順序でなぞるだけでは、脳は新しい刺激を受けません。そこで効果があるのが、問題を解く前に答えを予想する、解いた後に自分の言葉で説明し直すといった一手間です。この小さな工夫が、意図的な練習の入口になります。週に一度だけでも、今のやり方は本当に効いているのかと疑う時間を持てば、勉強の質は目に見えて変わります。
cards.en: Many people who can't keep studying don't have weak willpower; their way of working has just slid into inertia. Merely tracing the same reference book in the same order gives the brain no new stimulus. What works is a little extra step, such as predicting the answer before solving a problem or re-explaining it in your own words afterward. This small trick becomes the entrance to deliberate practice. Even once a week, if you take time to question whether your current method is really working, the quality of your study visibly changes.

words.defJa: 気分のよい悪いの差が大きいこと

cards.ja: 上司がさ、朝は機嫌いいのに午後になると急に不機嫌になる人で、感情の起伏が激しいんだよね。こっちは顔色をうかがってばかりで疲れていたところに、同僚がチョコを渡したら一発で直ったんだよ。実は低血糖でイライラしてたらしくて。笑い話みたいだけど、心身の状態って、思ってる以上に人間関係を左右するよね。その日から、うちの部署の引き出しには、いざというときのためのチョコが常備されるようになったんだ。
cards.en: My boss is the type who's in a good mood in the morning but suddenly gets grumpy in the afternoon, with really big emotional ups and downs. Just when I was worn out from always watching his face, a coworker handed him some chocolate and it fixed him in one go. Apparently he'd been irritable from low blood sugar. It sounds like a joke, but the state of mind and body sways human relations more than you'd think. From that day, chocolate for emergencies has been kept in our department's drawer.

words.reading: しんりてきあんぜんせい
words.defJa: 失敗や異論を言っても安全な状態

cards.ja: グーグルが社内の生産性の高いチームを調べたところ、最も重要な要因として浮かび上がったのが心理的安全性だった。自分の意見や失敗を口にしても罰せられない、という感覚が、意思決定の場で共有されているかどうかである。皮肉なことに、問題を隠さない組織ほど、重大な事故を未然に防ぎやすいとされる。ただ、単に仲が良いことと同一視すると、緊張感を欠いた馴れ合いに陥りかねない。
cards.en: When Google examined its highly productive internal teams, the most important factor to emerge was psychological safety. It is whether the feeling that you will not be punished for voicing your opinions or failures is shared in the places where decisions are made. Ironically, organizations that do not hide problems are said to be better at preventing serious accidents before they happen. But if it is simply equated with being on friendly terms, it can slide into a cozy complacency that lacks tension.

words.reading: じょうけいびょうしゃ
words.defJa: 場面のようすを描き出す表現

cards.ja: 小論文や作文の採点では、情景描写が上手な答案ほど、読み手の印象に残りやすいと言われます。「暑かった」と書く代わりに、「アスファルトの上で陽炎が揺れていた」と書くだけで、場面の温度が伝わるからです。ただし、細部を並べすぎると、肝心の主張が埋もれてしまいます。五感のうち、いちばん効く一つか二つに絞ることが、短い字数で読み手を動かすコツです。逆に、作者の感想ばかりが続く文章は、どれだけ熱が入っていても読み手を置き去りにします。
cards.en: In grading short essays and compositions, it is said that answers with skillful scene description tend to stay in the reader's mind. Simply writing "heat shimmer wavered above the asphalt" instead of "it was hot" conveys the temperature of the scene. However, if you line up too many details, the main point you want to make gets buried. Narrowing it down to the one or two of the five senses that work best is the trick for moving the reader in a short word count. Conversely, writing that is nothing but the author's impressions leaves the reader behind no matter how much heat it carries.

words.defJa: 登場人物の心の動きを描くこと

cards.ja: 優れた小説は、「悲しかった」と書かずに悲しみを伝える。夏目漱石の『こころ』が長く読まれてきたのは、先生の沈黙や言い淀みのうちに、言葉にされない葛藤が滲んでいるからにほかならない。心理描写とは、内面を説明することではなく、行動や情景を通じて読者の側に感情を立ち上げさせる技術である。そこでは感受性の鋭い読み手ほど、行間に多くを見いだすことになる。漱石に限らず、優れた作家は読者の想像に余白を残す。
cards.en: A fine novel conveys sadness without writing "I was sad." Natsume Sōseki's Kokoro has been read for so long precisely because an unspoken inner conflict seeps through the teacher's silences and hesitations. Psychological portrayal is not a matter of explaining the inner life but the art of making the reader's own emotion rise through actions and scenery. There, the more sensitive the reader, the more they find between the lines. And it is not only Sōseki: fine writers leave room for the reader's imagination.

words.defJa: 考えるのをやめてしまうこと

cards.ja: 「前例がないからダメです」という一言ほど、組織を静かに腐らせるものはありません。何も考えていないわけではなくても、結果として思考停止に陥っているのです。トヨタ生産方式で「なぜ」を五回繰り返すのは、まさにこの停止を防ぐためだとされます。大事なのは、答えを出す前に問いを立て直す思考法を、日常の習慣にすることです。反対に、現場の誰もが「なぜ」と口にできる職場では、小さな不具合が大きな事故になる前に見つかります。
cards.en: Nothing quietly rots an organization like the single phrase "there is no precedent, so it can't be done." Even if you are not actually thinking about nothing, you have in effect fallen into a state of mental shutdown. Repeating "why" five times in the Toyota Production System is said to be exactly for preventing this halt. What matters is to make a way of thinking that reframes the question before giving an answer a part of daily habit. Conversely, in a workplace where anyone can say "why," small defects are found before they become big accidents.

words.defJa: 急ぐときほど確実な道を選べ

cards.ja: プログラミングの現場には、「急がば回れ」を地で行く名言があります。「まず動くものを作れ、次に正しいものを作れ、最後に速いものを作れ」という順序です。納期に追われると、いきなり最適化に手を出し、あとで大きな手戻りを招きかねません。回り道に見える設計の工程こそ、結局は最短の道なのだと、この言葉は教えてくれます。この諺は、近道より安全な遠回りを選べという戒めで、室町時代の連歌師、宗長の歌に由来するとされます。
cards.en: In the world of programming there is a famous saying that puts "more haste, less speed" into practice. The order goes: first make it work, then make it right, and finally make it fast. When pressed by a deadline, people jump straight into optimization and may well bring on a big rework later. The design stage, which looks like a detour, is in the end the shortest road, these words teach us. This proverb is a caution to choose the safe long way around over the shortcut, and is said to derive from a poem by the Muromachi-period renga master Sōchō.

words.defJa: ついなまけてしまう癖

cards.ja: 在宅勤務が定着して数年、「怠け癖がついた」と感じる会社員は少なくないようだ。通勤という強制力が消えたことで、始業までの切り替えが各自の意志力に委ねられたためである。専門家は、気合に頼るのではなく、作業を始める合図となる習慣を決めておくよう助言する。ただ、個人の問題として片づけてしまえば、職場の仕組みに潜む原因を見逃すことにもなりかねない。朝の十分間だけ机に向かう、といった小さな決まりのほうが長続きするという。
cards.en: Several years after working from home took hold, quite a few office workers seem to feel that they have fallen into lazy habits. This is because, with the compulsion of commuting gone, the switch into work mode has been left to each person's willpower. Experts advise deciding on a habit that serves as the cue for starting a task rather than relying on sheer spirit. But if it is dismissed as an individual problem, one may well overlook causes lurking in the workplace's arrangements. Small rules, such as sitting at the desk for just ten minutes in the morning, are said to last longer.

words.defJa: 経済が急に混乱する危機

cards.ja: 一九二九年十月、ニューヨークの株式市場が暴落し、それが世界恐慌の引き金になりました。銀行が次々に破綻し、失業者があふれ、各国は自国の産業を守ろうと関税を引き上げます。その結果、貿易がさらに縮み、不況は国境を越えて深まっていきました。この苦い経験があるからこそ、現代の各国中央銀行は、危機の兆しを見るやいなや、大量の資金供給に踏み切るのです。株価の暴落だけでなく、そこから連鎖する信用の収縮が、事態を決定的に悪化させたのです。
cards.en: In October 1929 the New York stock market crashed, and that became the trigger of the Great Depression. Banks failed one after another, the unemployed overflowed, and each country raised tariffs to protect its own industry. As a result, trade shrank even further, and the slump deepened across borders. Precisely because of this bitter experience, today's central banks move to inject huge amounts of money the instant they see signs of crisis. It was not only the plunge in share prices but the contraction of credit chained from it that decisively worsened matters.

words.defJa: ものの考え方や筋道

cards.ja: フェルミ推定とは、東京にピアノ調律師が何人いるかといった、見当もつかない数を筋道立てて見積もる思考法です。人口、世帯の保有率、調律の頻度、一人が一日にこなせる台数と、順に想定を置いて掛け合わせていきます。正確な答えを出すことが目的ではなく、どこが分からないのかを明確にすることに価値があるのです。コンサルティング会社の採用試験で出題されたことから、広く知られるようになりました。
cards.en: A Fermi estimate is a way of thinking in which you reason step by step to estimate a number you have no clue about, such as how many piano tuners there are in Tokyo. You set assumptions in turn, population, the share of households owning one, how often tuning happens, how many a person can do in a day, and multiply them together. The point is not to produce an accurate answer but to make clear where you do not know something. It became widely known through being asked in the hiring tests of consulting firms.
